items.text: During the Q2 security audit of our checkout flow, the external firm flagged that session tokens were not being rotated after privilege changes. The report notes that the customer-support chatbot's backend shares the same token store, so the fix must be coordinated with the AI platform team. We've scheduled a remediation review for July 12; all findings are tracked in JIRA under SEC-4471. No customer data was exposed, but the auditors recommend enabling token rotation within 30 days.
The gym membership portal will be down for maintenance on Saturday from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC; the automated reminder emails will still go out as scheduled.
Please review the attached conference schedule for the support team; note that the AI assistant demo is in Hall B at 14:00.
The security audit found no critical issues in the chatbot's authentication flow, but we need to update the API keys by Friday.
Gym membership renewals for Q3 will be processed automatically starting next week; the finance team will send a separate note about payment methods.

Minutes from the Security Audit Review Meeting – June 18, 2025

Present: Maya Chen (Security Lead), Omar Farouk (Infrastructure), Priya Nair (Customer Support), Tom Becker (AI Platform).

1. Maya presented the findings from the external audit. Three medium-severity issues were identified in the customer-support chatbot's data handling: insufficient logging of user queries, lack of rate limiting on the /chat endpoint, and outdated TLS certificates on the fallback server.

2. Omar noted that the TLS certificates were renewed on June 15 and the change is already in production. He will add rate limiting to the API gateway by June 25.

3. Priya raised a concern that support agents rely on the chatbot's transcript summaries for escalated tickets. Tom confirmed that logging improvements will capture full transcripts with PII redaction, and that the AI team will share the updated schema with support by July 1.

4. Action items:
   - Omar: implement rate limiting (due June 25)
   - Tom: share logging schema (due July 1)
   - Maya: schedule follow-up audit in Q4
   - Priya: update support KB with new escalation steps for chatbot errors

5. Next meeting: July 16, 2025, 10:00 AM in Conference Room B.

The annual gym membership policy for employees has been updated: the company will now cover up to $50 per month for gym memberships, effective July 1. Employees must submit receipts through the HR portal by the 5th of each month. The automated reimbursement system will process approved claims within 10 business days. Questions can be directed to hr@lumina-shop.com.

Security Audit Findings – Customer Support Chatbot

Overview: The external audit conducted on June 10-12, 2025, assessed the security posture of the customer-support chatbot and its integrations. The scope included authentication, data storage, and third-party API usage.

Findings:
- Medium: Session tokens are not rotated after privilege escalation. Recommendation: implement token rotation on role change.
- Low: Chatbot logs contain unredacted email addresses. Recommendation: apply PII redaction before storage.
- Informational: The chatbot's fallback to human agents is triggered after 3 failed attempts; consider increasing to 5 to reduce false escalations.

Remediation Plan:
The AI platform team will address the medium finding by July 15 and the low finding by July 30. The informational item will be reviewed in the next quarterly planning. No critical or high findings were identified. The audit report is available in the shared drive under Security/Audits/2025.

The gym membership chatbot handles over 500 inquiries per day, according to the latest support metrics. Most users ask about hours, class schedules, and cancellation policies. The automated responses resolve 70% of queries without human intervention, but complex cases are escalated to the front desk. A recent update added the ability to check membership status via the chatbot, which reduced call volume by 15%.
